limits: No production dependency, native client wiring, discoverable pairing listener, stored identity creation, or input authorization
No Mac native build or cross-machine pairing verification
ApprovedBinding is past local approval evidence, not remote delivery or durable bilateral completion; future trust commit needs separate policy
A process restart loses the rate budget and all invitations; codes must never be persisted or restored across restarts
Low-level Pairing remains an explicit primitive; callers bypassing InvitationManager do not receive its lifecycle limits
